title: GG SMP
description: A server with custom bosses, items, skills and more that does not require mods to join.
body:
GG SMP is a server with multiple custom bosses, beatable in custom builds via /warp, custom skills using AuraSkills, and it uses toeny for players to interact with their friends. it also has custom enchantments. 
other features include:
- an auction house
- in game shop
- item linking in chat
- discord to Minecraft linking
And more! join now.
